Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning mosquito abatement in storm water control retention ponds.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to mosquito abatement in storm water controlretention ponds; and adding a new section to chapter 90.03 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 90.03 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: A county, city, town, water-sewer district, or flood control zonedistrict constructing, improving, operating, or maintaining storm watercontrol facilities under RCW 35.67.020, 35.92.020, 36.89.080,36.94.140, 57.08.005, or 57.08.081, must use integrated pest managementmosquito control abatement methods in wet ponds, storm water retentionponds, wet retention ponds, or wet extended detention ponds as part ofa storm water control facility for which the primary function of thepond is to detain storm water.
